svg.title: Prisma Compute vs Vercel Pricing
svg.desc: A line by line pricing table for one 20M request month: Prisma Compute totals about 98 dollars against about 236 dollars on Vercel Pro, with the seat fee the only line Prisma does not charge. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism red accent.

g.text: 20M requests · 1,460 GB-hours · 300 vCPU-hours · 2 TB out · 1 seat
